home.title: Take your time to meet.
home.intro: A detail that makes you smile. An answer that leaves you curious. Here, words come before photos, which you both choose to reveal.

time.title: Time
time.text: Read an answer to the end. Find your words. Let a conversation take shape.

reciprocity.title: Reciprocity
reciprocity.text: The wish to connect has to be mutual. To start talking, and to choose to continue.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: Be free to say yes, say no, block or report. And stay in control of what you share.

home.rhythmTitle: The wish to talk. Then to keep talking.
home.rhythmIntro: You choose who sparks your curiosity, what you share and what comes next. Together, at every step.

preferences.title: Define what matters
preferences.text: A few words about you, what you’re looking for and what makes you you. No role to play.

mutualChoice.title: Choose each other
mutualChoice.text: A detail catches your eye? Show your interest. A conversation only starts when the feeling is mutual.

conversation.title: Talk for 24 hours
conversation.text: A first hello and 24 hours to talk, without photos shown straight away. Room for words to find their way.

continuation.title: Continue and reveal together
continuation.text: After 24 hours, messaging pauses. If you both choose to continue, the conversation resumes. A refusal ends the match without revealing who declined. Sharing photos is a separate choice, always mutual.

home.featuresTitle: Getting to know each other, simply.
home.featuresIntro: An introduction that feels like you, wishes that align and the freedom to move at your own pace.

profiles.title: What moves you
profiles.text: A passion, an answer, a character trait. Your profile offers a glimpse of the person behind the words.

preferences.title: Wishes that align
preferences.text: Age, distance and who you’re looking for matter on both sides. Your preferences and theirs carry equal weight.

location.title: Someone nearby
location.text: With your permission, Histae uses a recent location to find people nearby. Others see a rounded distance, never your exact location.

likes.title: A shared curiosity
likes.text: Do you both want to know more? That’s the start of a match. One-sided interest stays private.

matches.title: The wish to keep talking
matches.text: After the first 24 hours, each person has another 24 hours to choose what comes next. It takes two yeses to resume the conversation.

photoReveal.title: A face, at the right moment
photoReveal.text: When you both want to, your photos are revealed. Continuing to talk never obliges you to show them.

messaging.title: Your words, your conversation
messaging.text: A place to write, read and reply. Read receipts show when your messages are marked as read.

privacy.title: Your boundaries matter
privacy.text: Change consent, block someone, report a problem or request your data: these choices stay within reach in your account.

home.safetyText: Histae includes blocking, reporting, moderation and directly accessible data rights. Sensitive choices, such as location and preferences, rely on explicit consent that can be withdrawn. The source code is public so anyone can examine it and audit its security.
home.closingTitle: A connection at your own pace.
home.closingText: Histae is getting ready to welcome you on iOS and Android. You’ll find the download links here at launch.
